hypotheses.text: A Standardized Three-Assay Systemic BiomarkerFramework for Evaluating RSV Protection in Infants: Integrating Subtype-SpecificNeutralizing Titers, Orthogonal Epitope-Specific Competition, and Mucosal-Systemic IgA withGrowth-Coupled Allometric Decay Modeling

claims.text: Core biomarker panel to evaluate RSV protection in infants comprises subtype-specific serum neutralizing antibody (SNA) titers, prefusion F-specific ADCP activity, and palivizumab-competitiveantibody (PCA) titer.
The framework utilizes standard assays calibrated against the WHO 2nd international reference standard
